description: Makes Steam Link fully functional on Samsung Galaxy XR. Adds Android XR / OpenXR permissions and features, HMD and controller identity configs, Galaxy XR bridge native libraries, safe permission handling, the launcher bootstrap, and managed-panel aspect correction with XR spatial-pointer button input. This patch is required for Galaxy XR operation.
name: Android XR compatibility

description: Renames the app package so it can be installed alongside the original Steam Link. Default appends '.gxr'. Changing the package name may break features that rely on the original identity.
name: Change package name

options.description: New package name, e.g. com.valvesoftware.steamlink.gxr. Leave 'Default' to append '.gxr' automatically.
options.title: Package name

description: Experimental: derives current controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history, avoiding delayed runtime velocity during throws.
name: Controller velocity fix

options.description: Falls back to runtime velocity when pose samples are farther apart. Allowed range: 5 to 100 ms.
options.title: Maximum sample gap (ms)

options.description: Previous-output weight. 0 gives minimum lag; higher values reduce jitter. Allowed range: 0.0 to 0.9.
options.title: Derived velocity smoothing

options.description: Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived speed. Allowed range: 1 to 50 m/s.
options.title: Maximum linear speed (m/s)

options.description: Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.
options.title: Maximum angular speed (rad/s)

description: Overrides the HMD manufacturer/model identity reported to SteamVR (hmd_config.json only; controller identity is unaffected). 'samsung-default' leaves the file untouched.
name: Device identity

options.description: Which HMD identity to report to SteamVR.
options.title: HMD identity

description: Installs libgxr_face_bridge.so (XR_FB_face_tracking2 → XR_ANDROID_face_tracking API layer) and adds android.permission.FACE_TRACKING to the manifest.
name: GXR face bridge

description: Adds a configurable offset to the HMD OpenXR pose-query time and zeroes all six exported HMD velocity fields. Does not affect controller paths.
name: HMD-only pose fix

options.description: Milliseconds added to HMD pose-query time. Tested default: 78 ms. Allowed range: 0 to 4000 ms.
options.title: Pose offset (ms)

description: Replaces VRLink's embedded GLSL fragment shader with configurable Galaxy XR OLED gamma and saturation correction.
name: OLED color calibration

options.description: Tested profiles: Initial uses gamma 1.06 and saturation 1.12; Final balanced uses gamma 1.20 and saturation 1.45. Custom uses number inputs below.
options.title: Calibration profile

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Tested values: 1.06 (Initial) and 1.20 (Final balanced). Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.
options.title: Gamma

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Tested values: 1.12 (Initial) and 1.45 (Final balanced). Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.
options.title: Saturation

description: Enables (or disables) the dormant GLSL dither term in VRLink's video fragment shader. Reduces 8-bit contouring on OLED displays.
name: Video dither

options.description: True to uncomment the dither line; false to recomment it.
options.title: Enable dither

description: Keeps the watch history and resume positions on your own server instead of Google's, so YouTube's history can stay off. Requires Morphe official patches and a yt-history server.

options.description: Base URL of the history API of your yt-history server.
options.title: Server URL

options.description: Sent to the server in the X-Token header. Leave empty to use YT_HISTORY_TOKEN from the environment or from ~/.config/env/yt-history on the computer that patches.
